abstract: BACKGROUND: The objective of this study was to evaluate the efficacy and safety of first-line high-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) combined with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation (PBSCT) for patients with advanced extragonadal germ cell tumors (EGGCT). METHODS: Six male patients with advanced non-seminomatous EGGCT were treated with HDCT combined with PBSCT following 2-3 cycles of conventional-dose induction chemotherapy. The regimens used for HDCT were carboplatin, etoposide and ifosfamide (ICE) in five patients and ICE plus paclitaxel (T-ICE) in one patient, and that for induction therapy was cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin (PEB) in all patients. As a rule, HDCT was continuously administered until alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and beta-human chorionic gonadotropin normalized (beta-HCG). RESULTS: Following 1-6 courses of HDCT (median, 4 courses), beta-HCG and AFP were normalized in all patients, and five and one patient were diagnosed as showing partial remission and stable disease, respectively. Five patients underwent surgical resection of residual tumors after HDCT, yielding necrotic tissue in two, mature teratoma in two, and viable cancer tissue in one, and the surgical margin was negative in all patients. At a median follow-up of 36 months, five patients were alive and disease-free, whereas the remaining one died of disease progression. Although all patients had grade 3 hematological toxicity, there was no treatment-related death by combining PBSCT. CONCLUSIONS: First-line HDCT with PBSCT could be safely administered to patients with advanced EGGCT, and the antitumor effect of this treatment was comparatively favorable. First-line HDCT therefore may represent an attractive option for patients with advanced EGGCT.
abstract_ja: 背景：進行性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍(EGGCT)患者に対する初回大量化学療法(HDCT)と末梢血幹細胞移植(PBSCT)の有効性と安全性を評価することを目的とした。方法：進行性非セミノーマ性EGGCTの男性患者6例に対し、従来量の導入化学療法2～3コース後にHDCTとPBSCTを実施した。HDCTのレジメンは、5例でカルボプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミド(ICE)、1例でICEにパクリタキセルを加えたレジメン(T-ICE)であった。導入療法はすべての患者でシスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン(PEB)であった。原則として、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-hCGが正常化するまでHDCTを継続投与した。結果：HDCT 1～6コース(中央値4コース)後、全例でβ-hCGとAFPが正常化した。5例が部分寛解、1例が安定と診断された。HDCT後に5例が残存腫瘍の外科的切除を受け、壊死組織が2例、成熟奇形腫が2例、生存癌組織が1例で認められ、全例で切除断端は陰性であった。追跡期間中央値36か月で、5例が生存し無病、残る1例が病勢進行により死亡した。全例でグレード3の血液毒性がみられたが、PBSCTの併用による治療関連死はなかった。結論：進行性EGGCT患者に対する初回HDCTとPBSCTは安全に施行可能で、抗腫瘍効果も比較的良好であった。したがって初回HDCTは進行性EGGCT患者にとって魅力的な選択肢となりうる。
